INVITATION TO BID FOR TEN (10) UNITS LAPTOP FOR THE USE OF
THE OFFICE OF THE SANGGUNIANG BAYAN, MIAGAO, ILOILO
1. The Municipality of Miagao through the Budget for the Contract Approved by the
Sanggunian, Account Number 1021-1-07-05-030 Budget Year 2018 intends to apply
the sum of P 350,000.00 being the Approved Budget for the Contract (ABC) to
payments under the contract for Ten (10) Units Laptop for the use of the Office of the
Sangguniang Bayan, Miagao, Iloilo. Bids received in excess of the ABC shall be
automatically rejected at bid opening.
2. The Municipality of Miagao now invites bids for the following:
ITEM
NO. | QUANTITY | UNIT ITEM DESCRIPTION
1 jae Ten (10) Units laptop bundled with one unit Network
1 Attached Storage with the following minimum
specifications:
for laptop:
PROCESSOR: 2-CORE, 4 THREADS
6TH GEN processor (3MB L3 cache, 2.0 GHz)
MEMORY: 4GB of DDR4 system memory
OS: LATEST, 64-bit OS
HARD DISK: 1TB 2.5 inch 5400 RPM
DISPLAY: 15" HD+
ODD: DVD +/-RW
GRAPHICS: Integrated HD
EXTERNAL: USB 3.0, USB 2.0 and HDMI port ports, support
I/O PORTS: Ethernet (RJ-45) and External display (VGA)
port
OTHERS: HD Webcam, speakers, microphone, WiFi
BATTERY: 4-cell Li-ion battery pack
WARRANTY: 1 year Limited Local Warranty (Parts and
Labor)
CASE / BAG: Carrying Bag / knapsack/case
for NAS:
2 Drive Bays, RJ-45 connection with 2 units
1 TB SATA HDD
